items.excerpt: A Tel Aviv University study finds a fundamental flaw in using AI to decode animal communication: acoustic similarity does not guarantee equivalent meaning. AI models failed to classify toddler vocalizations by actual intent, suggesting decoding animal language needs behavioral observation and brain measurement alongside AI.

Researchers used automated robotics plus chemical AI to sweep 960 reaction conditions of the 135-year-old Biginelli reaction, uncovering a previously unknown branch that yields complex bicyclic molecules with metal-responsive assembly and programmable chiral sorting.

University of Edinburgh researchers built room-temperature skyrmion-based artificial synapses that exploit collective magnetic transformations rather than individual skyrmion manipulation, pointing to far lower energy consumption for AI hardware at high computational accuracy.
A search for the most complex elliptic curves had taken mathematicians years. Claude beat the record in days, raising questions about how much of mathematical search work AI can now absorb.
After an OpenAI model presented a possible solution to the Navier-Stokes problem, mathematicians are speculating about which Millennium Prize problem machines could crack next.

The speech of people with schizophrenia sounds subtly different from that of healthy counterparts. Researchers are testing whether AI speech models can hear those differences early enough to aid diagnosis.
The OpenAI Foundation is funding a new effort called Data for Public Health, paying labs to generate the biological datasets that AI models for science currently lack.
Swarms of AI agents could supercharge scientific progress or wreak havoc. New research from Google DeepMind shows agents spontaneously reporting peers that cheated in a shared simulated society.
IonQ, Oak Ridge National Laboratory and research partners demonstrated a generative AI method that sharply reduces parameter-tuning time for quantum optimization circuits.
As researchers struggle to understand the emerging psychology inside AI systems, we may be overlooking what AI is doing to the psychology of the humans using it.
Most people either blindly trust AI or reject it outright. Research suggests the real skill is calibration — knowing when the algorithm beats intuition — and that it can be learned.

UCL scientists reconstructed 10-second videos from the brain activity of mice using only signals from neurons in the visual cortex, a decoding advance that could reveal how the brain reshapes what we see before it becomes perception.
NASA and IBM have released a Lunar Foundation Model, an AI trained to sift the mountains of data the agency has gathered about the moon and map its surface in unprecedented detail.
Monitoring Earth from orbit is messy: clouds block views and sun angles shift. Researchers propose 'liquid' neural networks that adapt continuously to noisy, irregular satellite data.
A new AI approach models decades of climate variability to show how batteries and hydrogen storage can make renewable energy systems reliable under extreme weather years.
DeepMind's WeatherNext 3, its most advanced global weather AI model, is now shipping in Search, Gemini, Maps, Google Maps Platform and Cloud, with sharper 15-day probabilistic forecasts.

AI is unlikely to launch a Hollywood-style war against humanity, argues this essay. The real hazard is premature trust — handing judgment to systems that will disappoint us in mundane, consequential ways.

FairJourney Biologics is consolidating antibody discovery data across multiple international sites onto a single AI platform, restructuring how a wet-lab discovery org captures and reuses its experimental record.
In a live recording from the International Congress of Mathematicians, leading mathematicians debate what mathematics is actually for once machines can produce proofs.
New documents reveal problems with the rushed launch of Medicare's AI prior-authorization pilot, an early real-world test of algorithmic decision-making inside clinical coverage.
